extraction.policy_summary: Tata Steel states it has an Equal Opportunity Policy in accordance with the provisions of the RPwD Act, 2016, and that the Tata Code of Conduct incorporates fundamental equal opportunity principles.
extraction.accommodation_process_summary: New buildings are built to meet accessibility standards and existing workstations/washrooms are being modified. Differently-abled employees receive tailored laptops and assistive software/hardware for their specific needs, and workplace productivity software (O365) has built-in accessibility features. New differently-abled employees are given company accommodation near the office during onboarding and assigned a buddy to help with relocation and workplace familiarisation.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As of FY2025-26 (Tata Steel Consolidated): 149 differently-abled employees (148 permanent + 1 other-than-permanent; 140 male/94%, 9 female/6%) and 118 differently-abled workers, all permanent (114 male/96.6%, 4 female/3.4%). Note: data excludes Tata Steel's European subsidiaries, which do not capture this data in line with local data-privacy practice.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: New buildings meet accessibility standards; existing workstations and washrooms are being modified for accessibility. Ramps, elevators and disabled-friendly washrooms are being installed at all Tata Steel India premises to ensure compliance with the RPwD Act, 2016, for both employees and visitors.
extraction.digital_accessibility_measures: Differently-abled employees are given tailored laptops and assistive software/hardware suited to their specific needs. The company's workplace productivity software (O365) has built-in accessibility features.
extraction.compliance_details: Tata Steel states it complies with the RPwD Act, 2016, ensuring accessibility at all its India locations, and that it has taken steps to ensure premises are accessible to differently-abled visitors per the Act. No specific RPwD Act employment-quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is disclosed.
